title: GoldPlus normalized performance metric record
description: One record per provider × page × device × location × metric. A metric the provider does not expose is recorded with value null and unit 'unsupported'; nothing is inferred.

provider.description: webpagetest | gtmetrix | debugbear | speedvitals | pingdom | yellowlab | keycdn | wpt_ecommerce_flow | k6 | artillery | loaderio | speedcurve | observatory | webhint | control

page.description: home | shop | product | cart | checkout | flow | site

location.description: provider location id or region, n/a when not applicable

source.description: the API or tool the number came from

run_ref.description: provider-side test id / result URL where permitted
